episode_summary: In this episode, Grant Muller shares his journey from addiction to becoming a top 1% real estate producer. He emphasizes the importance of moving from being top of mind to top of heart with clients by building genuine relationships. Grant also discusses strategies for thriving in challenging markets and the role of coaching in achieving personal and professional growth.
